_comment: Citation for the 10e Fight-phase alternation (both armies' engaged units fight in each Fight phase, alternating one at a time across a Fights First step then a Remaining Combats step). Built env-gated behind SWEG_FIGHTALT (Group-2 #2). Order VERIFIED from Wahapedia quick-start (canonical, CLAUDE.md rule 6/10): 'Units that charged this turn fight before all others. Then, starting with the player not currently taking their turn, players alternate fighting with their units.' So the Fights First step (chargers + Fights First keyword) starts with the ACTIVE player, and the Remaining Combats step starts with the NON-ACTIVE player (the defender picks first). An earlier active-first-both-steps reading was a mis-read, corrected here.

simulator.fight_alternation.rule_name: Fight phase — alternating activations (Fights First, then Remaining Combats)
simulator.fight_alternation.quoted_text: Units that charged this turn fight before all others. Then, starting with the player not currently taking their turn, players alternate fighting with their units. [Fight phase: a Fights First step (units that charged this turn or have the Fights First ability) then a Remaining Combats step; in each step the players alternate selecting one eligible unit to fight, one at a time. A unit is eligible to fight if it is within Engagement Range of an enemy unit or it made a Charge move this turn.]
simulator.fight_alternation.trigger: Group-2 #2 (env-gated SWEG_FIGHTALT): a Fight phase is being resolved. The vanilla loop fought ONLY the active army's units, deferring the defender's retaliation to its own later turn; under the gate, BOTH armies' eligible units fight in this Fight phase, alternating one at a time — the Fights First step (chargers + Fights First) starting with the ACTIVE player, the Remaining Combats step starting with the NON-ACTIVE player (the defender first)
simulator.fight_alternation.effect: Battle._run_fight_alternation resolves the Fight phase faithfully: it collects each army's eligible units (within 1" Engagement Range of an enemy, or having charged this turn) and the players alternate fighting one unit at a time — Fights First units (chargers + the Fights First keyword) first (active player selecting first), then the remaining units (NON-active/defender selecting first, the verified 10e order). Each unit fights at most once per Fight phase; because a battle round runs both players' turns, a unit locked across both turns fights in BOTH fight phases (twice per round, as 10e intends). This makes a charged defender swing back in-phase before it is deleted, removing the over-credit the wave-163 instrument proved differentially favours melee aggressors (denied-retaliation per battle: World Eaters 56.5 vs T'au 1.9). Faithful and faction-neutral (correct even if it moves the metric the wrong way). Default OFF; SWEG_FIGHTALT=1 enables the isolation A/B. The gate-off path runs the original active-only fight loop verbatim, so it is byte-identical.
